steps.en: Install/load the extension and configure backing before first access
steps.zh: 安装加载扩展，首次访问前配置后端

steps.en: Attach a virtual database and write tables
steps.zh: 挂载虚拟数据库并写表

steps.en: Translate database file access into SlateDB chunks
steps.zh: 把数据库文件访问转为 SlateDB 分块

steps.en: Checkpoint the database under exclusive writer ownership
steps.zh: 在唯一写者条件下执行检查点

steps.en: Persist database and recovery files in the selected backend
steps.zh: 在指定后端持久化数据库及恢复文件

value.en: Native DuckDB persistence through local or object backing without a database server
value.zh: 无需数据库服务器，让原生 DuckDB 使用本地或对象后端持久化
